name: Best Buy Plaza
summary: Best Buy Plaza is a well-positioned shopping center on North Central Expressway in Dallas, anchored by Best Buy and Total Wine & More. Located just north of NorthPark Center in one of North Texas's highest density trade areas, it serves an affluent customer base with convenient access and quality retail offerings.
demographics: Best Buy Plaza serves an affluent Dallas trade area with high household incomes, drawing from the prestigious neighborhoods surrounding NorthPark Center. The primary visitor demographic consists of middle to upper-middle class professionals aged 30-55 with above-average disposable income, seeking electronics, specialty retail, and convenience shopping. The center benefits from one of the highest density trade areas in North Texas, attracting tech-savvy consumers and wine enthusiasts who value quality products and convenient access via Central Expressway.
description: Best Buy Plaza is a premier shopping destination strategically located at 9378 North Central Expressway in Dallas, Texas, positioned just north of NorthPark Center, the highest grossing mall in Texas. This well-anchored shopping center features Best Buy and Total Wine & More as its primary tenants, offering shoppers a compelling mix of electronics, specialty beverages, and retail services. Situated in one of the highest density trade areas in all of North Texas, the center serves an affluent and growing customer base with convenient access from Central Expressway. The property is professionally managed and operated by CIM Group, a community-focused real estate owner and operator known for quality retail properties. With daily hours from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM seven days a week, Best Buy Plaza provides a convenient shopping experience for Dallas residents and visitors seeking quality products in an accessible location.
